context: STEP 3/3 fixer. Class: content-missing-nothing-in-its-place (30 docs, biggest OPEN). Two agents landed root causes; one is PROVEN AND FIXED IN THE TREE: pdfbox-android packs a DeviceGray sample into all four ARGB lanes (g<<24|g<<16|g<<8|g) instead of 0xFF000000|..., so a grey picture's ALPHA IS ITS LUMINANCE and every dark pixel is transparent. 415_inline_images (8x8 inline DeviceGray block) therefore rendered a correct 120 pt square containing nothing: 89.04 share@5px with text_recall 100.0 and chars_missing 0. Fix in PdfToWord.java: declaresTransparency() asks the PDF's own dictionary (/SMask, /Mask, SMaskInData, stencil) and forceOpaque() sets only the alpha byte when nothing is declared. SCREENED: 415_inline_images 89.04 -> 0.00, nothing worse. Corpus scan: 415_inline_images is the ONLY document in the 213 with an inline image and there are ZERO grey XObject images, so the blast radius is one document - the attempt will read 'partial' (1 of 30), not kept, and that is the honest number. RATCHET NOT YET RUN. Second agent (content-missing-nothing-in-its-place-B-103610-346a.md) proved the ~1.44 pt median on mobile-bill/salary-slip/electricity-bill is a ladder of +0.50 pt steps, one per emitted w:tbl: the bottom rule is drawn outside the last row's box and never charged to the following flow (DocxWriter.java:6020 drops ruleTwHere when the row pitch binds; 6547-6554 sets ctx.lastBaseline to the box bottom with no rule).
